# homeassistant_device (Data Source)

Reads one device (`config/device_registry/list`), by ID, by name, or by identifier. Exactly one device must match.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Look a device up by the name shown in the UI. A name the user gave wins over the
# integration's name.
data "homeassistant_device" "desk_lamp" {
  name = "Desk Lamp"
}

output "desk_lamp_model" {
  value = data.homeassistant_device.desk_lamp.model
}

# Look a device up by one of its identifiers: unlike the name, it stays the same when the
# device is renamed, e.g. by the integration that discovered it.
data "homeassistant_device" "door_sensor" {
  identifier = ["mqtt", "zigbee2mqtt_0x00158d0004aaf230"]
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `device_id` (String) Device ID to look up. Set exactly one of `device_id`, `name` and `identifier`.
- `identifier` (List of String) Identifier to look up, e.g. `["mqtt", "zigbee2mqtt_0x00158d0004aaf230"]`: the device whose `identifiers` contain it, compared exactly. Unlike `name`, it does not change when the device is renamed. Set exactly one of `device_id`, `name` and `identifier`.
- `name` (String) Name to look up. It is compared with `name_by_user` first; only if no device has that `name_by_user` is it compared with the name the integration gave. Set exactly one of `device_id`, `name` and `identifier`. When the device is looked up otherwise, this is the name the integration gave, or null if it gave none.

### Read-Only

- `area_id` (String) ID of the device's area; null if it is in none.
- `config_entries` (List of String) IDs of the config entries the device belongs to.
- `connections` (List of List of String) Connections of the device, each a list such as `["mac", "dc:a6:32:54:1f:88"]`: the connection type, then its value.
- `identifiers` (List of List of String) Identifiers of the device, each a list such as `["mqtt", "zigbee2mqtt_0x00158d0004aaf230"]`: the integration's domain, then its ID. They stay the same when the device is renamed.
- `labels` (Set of String) IDs of the device's labels.
- `manufacturer` (String) Manufacturer; null if the integration reports none.
- `model` (String) Model; null if the integration reports none.
- `name_by_user` (String) Name the user gave the device; null if it has none.
- `sw_version` (String) Firmware or software version; null if the integration reports none.
